content.rendered:
Registration for 2021-2022 Kindergarten is now available online. Please click REGISTRATION to get started.

New families may sign up for a ParentVUE account at this site and complete registration. Parents of current and former Sherwood students must log in with their existing ParentVUE account or obtain a ParentVUE activation key to complete registration. Please contact Archer Glen Elementary at 503.825.5100 with any questions about ParentVUE activation.

A paper packet is available, also. Please call 503.825.5100 to request a packet.
